Messages.Author: Emile
Messages.Body:
I have a query about Heidelburg Castle, Germany, can you tap it at any
time?

For example during damage resolution can you tap it to move blood on to
the vampire to stop it going into torpor? or during the choose range
phase, after other maneuvers have been played can you tap it to give the
vampire a weapon, which they can use to maneuver and strike with?

According to the card text you can, just wondering what other people
think of the above examples, how fair/legal you feel they are?

Heidelburg Castle, Germany

Tap to transfer equipment cards, move blood, and transfer retainers
between any two ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount
of blood you move and which cards you transfer.)

Emile

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emile <emile.c...@bbc.co.uk> wrote:
> I have a query about Heidelburg Castle, Germany, can you tap it at any
> time?

No. It cannot be tapped during actions - it can be tapped outside of
the minion phase or between actions. This is errata.

> For example during damage resolution can you tap it to move blood on to
> the vampire to stop it going into torpor? or during the choose range
> phase, after other maneuvers have been played can you tap it to give the
> vampire a weapon, which they can use to maneuver and strike with?

No.

> According to the card text you can, just wondering what other people
> think of the above examples, how fair/legal you feel they are?

The errata was issued to address such problems.

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
> Emile wrote:
> I have a query about Heidelburg Castle, Germany, can you tap it at any
> time?

Prior to the following 7/7 rule, yes.

Heidelburg Castle, Germany:
Cannot be used during an action (including during a
combat, since that is part of the action now - including
combats resulting from blocks). Can be used after an
action resolves and before the next action begins, at the
beginning of any minion phase, or at any time outside of
the minion phase.

Noal McDonald
